description: Place an order for a tailored CV and cover letter. The order typically takes about 15 minutes to complete. The customer will receive an SMS confirming their order and another SMS when their documents are ready to download. Costs 1 credit per order.

customerPhone.description: Customer phone number including country code, must start with '+' (e.g. +27831234567). SMS notifications will be sent to this number.

cvMarkdown.description: The customer's current CV in markdown format. This is used as the basis for tailoring their documents.

jobDescription.description: The full job description the customer is applying for. The CV and cover letter will be tailored to match this role.

productId.description: The product ID that matches the customer's career level. Call get_pricing first to see available career-level tiers and their product IDs.

name: place_order
